MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 30

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

4. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 36

5. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 22
   C. 17
   D. 66

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

15. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 64

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

18. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

23. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 10

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
